title: A Modified Lateral Lumbar Interbody Fusion VS. Transforaminal Lumbar Interbody Fusion for Adult Degenerative Scoliosis
brief_summary: A modified lateral lumbar interbody fusion VS. transforaminal lumbar interbody fusion for the treatment of adult degenerative scoliosis with 2 year follow-up with a multiple center, randomized case-control study
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* at least 50 years of age, diagnosed with adult thoracolumbar scoliosis including any number of intervertebral levels between T8 and S1, unresponsive to conservative treatment for at least 6 months, and had a preoperative coronal Cobb angle of at least 10° and preoperative ODI score of at least 30%.

Exclusion Criteria:

* with prior lumbar fusion surgery or spondylolisthesis greater than Grade II
